My dear Miss Yonge	
[I ](/person/939)ought to have acknowledged the [copy](/book/62) for the new [number ](/periodical/78)earlier, but I wanted to write you a longer letter which I cant do today after all.
I would be glad to see what more you have written of [Bethlehem](/topic/177), when you have satisfied yourself - or at least approximately - who could satisfy themselves on such a subject.

The young [Artist](/person/500) is ready to [work](/topic/167) whenever you like.

Shall I [pay](/topic/160) the monthly sums to your [banker](/organisation/169) in London, or send you a cheque? I have also the £200 for the [Clever Woman](/book/58) to pay.

It is indeed glorious weather.

You should see us now at Tooting.

Yours most truly
A.

Macmillan
